title: Renewal & Fresh Vision
intro: The end of a first year is a strange thing to mark, because so little of it will be remembered by the person who lived it. This month looks back on it honestly and forward without dread — a year that changed everyone, a child who is becoming themselves, and mercy that does not run out.

keyScriptures.text: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it?
His compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

weeks.title: A Year That Changed Everyone
weeks.declaration: This year changed everyone in this house, not only you. That is worth saying out loud.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for what this year did in us. We would not undo it. Amen.

weeks.title: Look Back Kindly
weeks.declaration: There were parts of this year we got wrong. They are covered, and they are not the summary.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, take the shame out of what we got wrong this year. Let mercy have the last word. Amen.

weeks.title: Becoming Yourself
weeks.declaration: You are becoming a particular person, and it is happening in front of us. We are trying to pay attention while it does.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, thank You for who this child is turning out to be. Help us love that person, not an imagined one. Amen.

weeks.title: Into the Next Year
weeks.declaration: God is already in the next year. Whatever it holds, He arrived there first and is not anxious about any of it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, go before us into this next year. Let us walk into it expectant. Amen.

days.title: A Year That Changed Us
days.declaration: This year changed everyone here, not only you. That is worth saying out loud.

scripture.text: The new creation has come.

days.title: Look Back Kindly
days.declaration: There is much we got wrong. It is covered, and it is not the summary of the year.

scripture.text: He knows how we are formed.

days.title: Every Morning Started Again
days.declaration: Every morning this year started again, however the night went. That never ran out.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Becoming Someone
days.declaration: You are becoming a particular person, and we are watching it happen.

scripture.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body.

days.title: Something New
days.declaration: God is doing something new, and some of it is already starting where nobody can see.

scripture.text: See, I am doing a new thing!

days.title: Count What Grew
days.declaration: Look at what grew this year. Almost all of it happened while nobody was watching.

scripture.text: The seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.

days.title: Even the Hard Parts Used
days.declaration: Even the hard parts of this year were used. That is not the same as saying they were good.

scripture.text: In all things God works for the good of those who love him.

days.title: No Schedule Being Failed
days.declaration: You are not behind and neither are we. There is no schedule being failed here.

scripture.text: He has made everything beautiful in its time.

days.title: Remembering For You
days.declaration: We will remember this year for you until you are old enough to be told about it.

scripture.text: Mary treasured up all these things.

days.title: Name Who Helped
days.declaration: Thank God for everyone who helped this year. We will name them out loud.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances.

days.title: A Clean Page
days.declaration: There is a clean page ahead — not a page with the old writing showing through.

scripture.text: They shall be as white as snow.

days.title: Put One Thing Down
days.declaration: There is one thing we will not carry into next year. We are choosing it deliberately.

scripture.text: Let us throw off everything that hinders.

days.title: Grown More Than We Noticed
days.declaration: You have changed almost beyond recognition, gradually, without any of it being obvious.

scripture.text: The child grew and became strong.

days.title: Hope for the Year Ahead
days.declaration: We are allowed to expect good things. Hoping is not asking for disappointment.

scripture.text: Plans to give you hope and a future.

days.title: God Was Here
days.declaration: Look back and find where God turned up. It is clearer now than it was at the time.

scripture.text: Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it.

days.title: Same God Next Year
days.declaration: Everything else about next year is unknown. The One going with us is not.

scripture.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

days.title: We Made It
days.declaration: We got through the whole year. That is not nothing and it deserves marking.

scripture.text: Thus far the Lord has helped us.

days.title: New Things Feel Odd
days.declaration: The next stage will feel strange before it feels normal. That is not a warning.

scripture.text: New things I declare.

days.title: Rest Before Starting
days.declaration: We will rest before charging into the next year. Starting depleted is how good plans die.

scripture.text: Get some rest.

days.title: Nobody Here Is Finished
days.declaration: None of us is finished. God does not abandon half-built things, in you or in us.

scripture.text: He will carry it on to completion.

days.title: Forgiven for This Year
days.declaration: Whatever we got wrong is forgiven, not filed away. We can start again.

scripture.text: He is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins.

days.title: Say Thank You
days.declaration: Before the year ends, tell someone what they did for us. Do not save it up.

scripture.text: Encourage one another and build each other up.

days.title: Streams in Dry Places
days.declaration: God does good things in unpromising places. Nothing here is written off.

scripture.text: Streams in the wasteland.

days.title: A New Name Ahead
days.declaration: There are good names waiting for you that nobody has called you yet.

scripture.text: You will be called by a new name.

days.title: Walk, Do Not Charge
days.declaration: We will walk into the next year rather than sprint at it. Walking lasts longer.

scripture.text: Walk humbly with your God.

days.title: Loved All the Way Through
days.declaration: You were loved on every day of this year, including the ones we would rather forget.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Habits Over Resolutions
days.declaration: We will change one habit rather than make ten promises. That is how anything sticks.

scripture.text: I make it my slave.

days.title: More Ahead Than Behind
days.declaration: There is far more ahead of you than behind. This was only the first year of it.

scripture.text: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter.

days.title: Told Again Next Year
days.declaration: Everything said over you this year will be said again. You will hear it until you know it.

scripture.text: Impress them on your children.

days.title: Given Back Daily
days.declaration: You were given to us and we give you back daily. That will not change as you grow.

scripture.text: So now I give him to the Lord.

days.title: Carried Into the New
days.declaration: Everything from this year comes with us. We start the next one carrying all of it.

scripture.text: I have made you and I will carry you.
